title: Identification and validation of microglia-associated genes in ischemic stroke using single-cell and bulk RNA-seq.
authors: Qian, Dongliang; Lu, Shuangshuang; Hu, Yuanyuan; Leng, Bing; Qin, Xuanfeng
one_liner_zh: 该文用单细胞与bulk RNA-seq鉴定缺血性卒中微胶质相关基因，含分子对接但核心是转录组差异与表达验证，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联弱。
abstract: Ischemic stroke (IS) is an acute cerebrovascular disease characterized by high incidence and mortality. The mechanism of microglia in the pathogenesis of IS remains unclear. This study aimed to explore the key genes related to microglia in IS and their molecular mechanisms in the pathogenesis. In this study, the transcriptome data of IS were retrieved from public databases. Subsequently, candidate genes were identified through the intersection of microglia-related genes (MGGs) obtained via single-cell annotation and high-dimensional weighted gene co-expression network analysis (hdWGCNA) with differentially expressed genes (DEGs). Next, key genes were determined through protein-protein interaction (PPI) analysis and verification of expression levels. Afterwards, enrichment analysis, variation analysis, construction of regulatory networks, drug prediction, and molecular docking were performed to evaluate the role of key genes in the pathogenesis of IS. Ultimately, the quantitative real-time PCR (qRT-PCR) was applied to confirm the expression levels of DEGs in brain tissues between sham and transient middle cerebral artery occlusion (tMCAO) mice. A total of 1407 DEGs intersected with 100 MGGs, yielding 51 candidate genes. Subsequently, 3 key genes (Cd14, Csf1, and Tlr2) were successfully obtained. The study revealed that these 3 key genes were co-enriched in 4 pathways, such as leishmania infection and ribosomal, and there were differences in the enriched pathways among groups. Notably, the expression of the 3 key genes was regulated by multiple factors, including 32 microRNAs (miRNAs), such as mmu-miR-3072-5p and mmu-miR-3970, and 7 transcription factors (TFs), such as Sp1 and Nfkb1. Meanwhile, these 3 key genes predicted 8 common drugs. Interestingly, Tlr2 and Adapalene exhibited a strong binding affinity (- 9.73 kcal/mol). qRT-PCR analysis revealed significantly elevated mRNA expression levels of Cd14, Csf1, and Tlr2 in tMCAO mice compared to sham-operated controls (p < 0.01). This study identified and validated 3 key genes (Cd14, Csf1, and Tlr2) associated with IS, which may serve as novel targets for IS diagnosis and treatment strategies.
abstract_zh: 缺血性卒中（Ischemic stroke, IS）是一种急性脑血管疾病，具有高发病率和高死亡率的特点。小胶质细胞在IS发病机制中的作用尚不清楚。本研究旨在探索IS中与小胶质细胞相关的关键基因及其在发病机制中的分子机制。本研究从公共数据库中获取了IS的转录组数据。随后，通过单细胞注释和高维加权基因共表达网络分析（hdWGCNA）获得的小胶质细胞相关基因（MGGs）与差异表达基因（DEGs）的交集，鉴定出候选基因。接下来，通过蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）分析和表达水平验证确定关键基因。之后，进行富集分析、变异分析、调控网络构建、药物预测和分子对接，以评估关键基因在IS发病机制中的作用。最终，应用实时定量PCR（qRT-PCR）确认假手术组和短暂大脑中动脉闭塞（tMCAO）小鼠脑组织中DEGs的表达水平。共1407个DEGs与100个MGGs相交，得到51个候选基因。随后，成功获得3个关键基因（Cd14、Csf1和Tlr2）。研究揭示，这3个关键基因共同富集于4条通路，如利什曼病感染和核糖体通路，且各组间富集通路存在差异。值得注意的是，这3个关键基因的表达受多种因素调控，包括32个微小RNA（miRNAs），如mmu-miR-3072-5p和mmu-miR-3970，以及7个转录因子（TFs），如Sp1和Nfkb1。同时，这3个关键基因预测了8种共同药物。有趣的是，Tlr2和阿达帕林表现出强结合亲和力（-9.73 kcal/mol）。qRT-PCR分析显示，与假手术对照组相比，tMCAO小鼠中Cd14、Csf1和Tlr2的mRNA表达水平显著升高（p < 0.01）。本研究鉴定并验证了3个与IS相关的关键基因（Cd14、Csf1和Tlr2），这些基因可能作为IS诊断和治疗策略的新靶点。
